rows.unit: pence per GBP of rateable value
rows.measure: Non-domestic rates poundage, basic (the national non-domestic rate), rateable value up to GBP 51,000
rows.note: Business rates in Scotland (non-domestic rates): rateable value times the poundage, billed by the council; the national rate applies to every property, and the additional factors of SSI 2026/68 add to it above GBP 51,000; 49.8p in 2025-26 (the Order's explanatory note)

rows.unit: pence per GBP of rateable value

rows.note: the basic 48.1p (SSI 2026/39) plus the additional factor of 0.054 (5.4p, regulation 5 of SSI 2026/68); the sum is worked here, the two parts are each in law

rows.measure: Small Business Bonus Scheme: no rates at or below this rateable value (one property)
rows.note: 100% relief where the ratepayer's only entry in the valuation roll has a rateable value of GBP 12,000 or less

rows.measure: Small Business Bonus Scheme: relief tapers from 100% to 25% up to this rateable value (one property)
rows.note: relief percentage = 100 - (75 x (1 - ((15000 - RV) / 3000))) between GBP 12,001 and 15,000

source.title: Local government finance circular 7/2026: non-domestic rates relief guidance, Annex A (Tables 3 and 4)

rows.measure: Small Business Bonus Scheme: relief tapers from 25% to 0 up to this rateable value
rows.note: relief percentage = 25 x ((20000 - RV) / 5000) between GBP 15,001 and 20,000

source.title: Local government finance circular 7/2026: non-domestic rates relief guidance, Annex A (Tables 3 and 4)

rows.measure: Small Business Bonus Scheme: the most a business's properties may be worth together and qualify
rows.note: with several properties: 100% where they total GBP 12,000 or less; 25% on each property of GBP 15,000 or less where they total GBP 12,001 to 35,000 (tapering to 0 for a property of GBP 15,001 to 20,000); the scheme runs 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2029 under regulations made for 2026-27

rows.measure: Retail, hospitality and leisure relief on the mainland, rateable value up to GBP 100,000, licensed premises and music venues excepted
rows.note: the purposes of Schedule 1 of the regulations (bed and breakfast, guest house, camping and the like in the circular's list); restaurants and cafes are in the 40% class below, not this one; applies 2026-27, the scheme set for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2029

source.title: Local government finance circular 7/2026: non-domestic rates relief guidance, Annex A (Tables 3 and 4)

rows.measure: Licensed hospitality and music venue relief, rateable value up to GBP 100,000
